function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

**Where to Order a Cake – Quick Guide** | Category | What to Look For | Why It’s Great | |----------|------------------|----------------| | **Local Artisan Bakeries** | • In‑person or phone orders
• Fresh, seasonal ingredients
• Custom designs | • Supports your community
• Often offer tastings & personalized service | | **Online Cake Delivery Platforms** | • Nationwide delivery (e.g., Goldbelly, Cake Delivery, BakeShop)
• Photo galleries & pre‑made designs | • Huge selection of flavors & styles
• Easy ordering & tracking | | **Grocery Stores & Supermarkets** | • In‑store bakeries (Whole Foods, Kroger, Safeway)
• Online ordering & curbside pickup | • Convenient if you’re already shopping
• Usually have a “special occasion” section | | **Specialty Dessert Shops** | • Chocolate shops, cupcake boutiques, vegan bakeries | • Unique flavor profiles & creative presentations | | **Big‑Box Retailers** | • Walmart, Target, Costco | • Affordable, ready‑made cakes; some offer custom orders | | **Food‑Delivery Apps** | • DoorDash, Uber Eats, Postmates | • Same‑day delivery from local bakeries (check “cakes” filter) | --- ### How to Choose the Right Place 1. **Know Your Occasion** - Birthday, wedding, corporate event, or just a sweet treat? Some bakeries specialize in certain types (e.g., wedding cakes, cupcakes, vegan options). 2. **Check Delivery Radius** - Online platforms often list delivery zones. Local bakeries may only deliver within a few miles. 3. **Read Reviews & Ratings** - Look at recent customer photos and comments. Pay attention to texture, taste, and packaging. 4. **Ask About Customization** - If you want a specific design, flavor, or dietary restriction, confirm the baker can accommodate it. 5. **Confirm Timing** - Order early enough to allow for baking, shipping, and any last‑minute changes. Many sites require 24–48 h notice for custom orders. 6. **Compare Prices** - Factor in delivery fees, taxes, and any extra charges for special decorations or large sizes. --- ### Quick Start‑Up List (U.S. Focus) | Platform | Link | Highlights | |----------|------|------------| | **Goldbelly** | https://goldbelly.com | Nationwide delivery of iconic regional cakes (e.g., New York Black Forest, Chicago Deep‑Dish). | | **Cake Delivery** | https://www.cakedelivery.com | Custom cakes, quick delivery, same‑day options in many cities. | | **BakeShop** | https://bake.shop | Modern, Instagram‑ready cakes; easy online ordering. | | **Local Bakery Finder** | https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=cake&find_loc=YOUR+CITY | Filter by “delivery” or “take‑out.” | | **Amazon Fresh** | https://www.amazon.com/fresh | Ready‑made cakes, quick delivery in select metro areas. | | **DoorDash / Uber Eats** | Search “cake” in your city | Same‑day delivery from local bakeries. | --- ### Example Order Flow (Using an Online Platform) 1. **Visit the site** (e.g., Goldbelly). 2. **Search** for “birthday cake” or “wedding cake.” 3. **Filter** by size, flavor, and delivery date. 4. **Select** a design, add any custom text or decorations. 5. **Enter** delivery address and payment. 6. **Confirm** the order and keep the tracking number. --- ### Bonus Tips - **Seasonal Specials**: Many bakeries offer pumpkin spice in fall, peppermint in winter, or fresh fruit in summer. - **Dietary Needs**: Gluten‑free, vegan, keto, or nut‑free options are increasingly common—just ask! - **Gift Packaging**: Some services include a gift box or decorative wrapping; great for corporate gifts. - **Return Policy**: Check if the bakery offers a refund or replacement if the cake arrives damaged or unsatisfactory. --- #### Need a Recommendation for a Specific City? If you tell me your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local bakeries or delivery services that fit your needs. Happy cake hunting! 🍰
